Sam J: Passing Saturna to CS — closed last week. Contract notes: Dedicated (VPC) deployment, EU data residency, Okta SSO, initial commit ~10M tokens/month, expected burst patterns (daily ETL spikes). Renewal Feb 2027 (11mo). Primary customer contact: Elena (elena@saturna.co). Sales doc + contract: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/xyz/saturna-contract>. Key asks: 1) SSO setup + IdP metadata 2) validate rate-limit behavior on Dedicated pool (they hit a ~2k TPS-ish short burst during POC) 3) batch embeddings ingestion pattern needs long-running jobs. Please own kickoff and escalate infra if needed. @Maya C — can you take point on onboarding?

Maya C: Thanks Sam. I’ll own onboarding. Quick clarifying Qs: do we have staging Okta metadata and a test user? Also need the contract clause for support SLAs. Elena — can you share SSO metadata or give staging creds?

Sam J: Elena said security team will provide metadata by EOD tomorrow. Staging creds not provided yet — sales can prod. Contract clause is section 6.2 (SLA exceptions) — link above.

Maya C: OK. Plan: 1) schedule 30m kickoff with customer + solutions engineer (this week) 2) open ENG ticket for SSO/dedicated infra validation 3) open SUP ticket for rate-limit/ingress tests and monitoring hooks 4) share onboarding checklist + enablement deck to customer.

Maya C: Owners (tentative): Onboarding lead — Maya C; ENG owner — Devon E; Support ops — Arjun S; CS enablement materials — Maya C.

OnboardBot: Created checklist "saturna-onboarding" and scheduled initial task: "Kickoff call" for 2026-03-25. Ticket STK-412 created as placeholder.

Maya C: Devon — can you validate whether the Dedicated pool topology we provisioned supports the customer's burst profile? If not, recommend a config or temporary burst policy. Also confirm if prefix/KV caching can help their batch embedding runs.

Devon E: I’ll triage. Quick note: Dedicated pool was created with 4x A100-equivalent; default rate-limiter is set to 1200 tps per shard. If they saw ~2k spikes we'll likely need burst policy or an extra shard for ETL windows. I’ll open ENG-799 to run a repro using their ingestion pattern.

Arjun S: I’ll own monitoring and rate-limit ticket. Plan: run a controlled load test against Dedicated STAGE once SSO is in place, capture 95/99 latency and throttling events, and add dashboard panels. If we see token-queue buildup, we’ll enable temporary burst.

Maya C: Thanks. Also capture enablement asks: customer wants a short runbook for operators (how to tune batch size, kv cache settings, and fallback models). I’ll draft and share for review.

Sam J: FYI — Sales flagged this as a medium renewal risk (R = 6/10) because they care about performance and costs. If onboarding is smooth and burst handled, risk should drop.

Maya C: Noted. I’ll add a renewal-watch note to CRM and a checkpoint at 60 days post-kickoff to gauge satisfaction.

Devon E: ENG-799 created and assigned to me. ETA initial repro: 48 hours. Will post results and recommended config (burst policy vs extra shard).

Arjun S: SUP-215 opened for monitoring + load test. ETA: run test after staging Okta config is live (ask Elena for test IdP).

Maya C: Action items summary: - Maya: schedule kickoff + draft runbook (due 2026-03-26) - Devon: ENG-799 repro & config recommendation (due 48h) - Arjun: SUP-215 monitoring + load test (blocked until staging SSO) - Sam: follow up with Elena for staging metadata (by EOD tomorrow) - OnboardBot: keep checklist updated

Maya C: I'll post a short follow-up with calendar invite and link to onboarding doc once kickoff time is locked.

Sam J: Thanks team :thumbsup: — ping me if you need sales to surface any contractual SLAs or credits during remediation.

Devon E: Quick note for the run: I’ll include a small smoke script snippet they can run locally: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\": \"x\"}' https://dedicated.saturna.redwood/api/generate -o /dev/null` — will parameterize batch sizes.

Arjun S: Adding a dashboard tile to the "Saturna - Dedicated" board for token queue and throttle alerts.

Maya C: Great. Closing here for now; will reopen thread with kickoff notes.
